question: 2025年第四季度中，家用电器类目销售金额占该季度全部商品销售金额的比例是多少？（百分比，保留两位小数）
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(oi3.subtotal) FROM order_items oi3 JOIN orders o3 ON o3.id = oi3.order_id WHERE o3.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o3.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o3.status != 'cancelled'), 2) AS pct FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' AND c.name = '家用电器' GROUP BY c.id, c.name
pred_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.name = '家用电器' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS percentage FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
initial_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.name = '家用电器' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS percentage FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
